summaryForNext: 3 changes written on the openspec backend, all passing `openspec validate`. ZeeSpec: n/a (no .zeespec/, gate inactive). ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING and stated in EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md: conformance-baseline-gate -> conformance-close-capability-gaps -> conformance-l4-persistence. Changes 1 and 2 both edit capability_cases.rs and 2 and 3 edit it again, so they must not be parallelised. C-01: conformance-baseline-gate corrects the two miscalibrated assertions (capability_cases.rs:356 asserts 200 against an endpoint that guards unconditionally — the harness exposes HARNESS_JWT_SECRET at harness.rs:50 for exactly this; :511 asserts 200 against a route deliberately retired in favour of X-UAR-Session-ID with POST /api/chat/completion) and adds a blocking CI job, with the gate PROVEN by a deliberate break that names the failing case. C-02: conformance-close-capability-gaps defines the full label taxonomy, relabels stub-dependent l3_ cases to l2_, and closes the eight-capability hole with a PER-CAPABILITY TARGET EVIDENCE LEVEL rather than mere existence — C-21 tenant isolation needs a two-tenant cross-read returning denied not 404, C-25/26/27 assert against the published W3C vector and include fail-closed negatives, C-24 is a published exclusion because it needs two devices. C-03: conformance-l4-persistence exposes the shutdown that ALREADY EXISTS (server.rs:1386 CancellationToken, 1388-1420 signal handler, 1425-1438 shutdown_future, 1441/1453 wired) via one additive caller-supplied parameter on start_server_sidecar, which already takes a caller-supplied oneshot::Sender; adds a fixed-DB-path option to boot_test_server (currently unique_temp_path at harness.rs:143-149); and writes write-reboot-read round trips for C-12 and C-13 WITH A NEGATIVE CONTROL, because a round trip that passes against an empty store proves nothing. ADVERSARIAL REVIEW: MiniMax-M3 critic plus Kimi k3 judge, artifact-only, whole set in one packet. Verdict INSUFFICIENT with six findings, ALL UPHELD BY THE JUDGE AND ALL APPLIED — every one was about autonomous executability rather than correctness: implicit CI inheritance, a dangling 'the pinned command' reference, ambiguous discriminator scope across changes, no verification.md format, three deltas to one spec capability with no precedence rule, and an undefined boundary for whether absent_/excluded_ cases count as satisfied. Fixed by EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md (order, precedence — later change wins on conflicting requirement text, the verbatim pinned command, CI coverage of the whole set, discriminator scope binding ALL cases including baseline-gate's corrections, what counts as satisfied, one verification.md format, and stop conditions) plus local task edits. Re-validated after amendment: all three still valid. RISK: conformance-l4-persistence is the only change touching runtime source; task 1.1 is the entire permitted surface and anything beyond it is a stop condition.
